the complexity of communication breakdowns that occur in globally distributed virtual teams and how they can be resolved.
how virtual team members can develop and maintain shared meaning in a globally distributed context, which is a critical success factor for virtual team performance.

virtual teams require a high level of translucence in order to create shared meaning and to avoid breakdowns.

the organizational context is the basis of shared meaning in virtual team communication, and translucence is a key variable in building shared meaning.
building shared meaning in virtual team collaboration is not a linear process, and it cannot be reduced to one single level.
the communication breakdowns we identified in our case studies were not caused by a lack of face-to-face communication, but rather by a lack of shared understanding and meaning at the lifeword level.

the organizational context is an essential variable for virtual team communication breakdowns, and that the lifeworld context is an essential element for building shared meaning in virtual teams.
